========== D:\Projects\SelfHealingMachines\web\src\App.tsx ==========

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Toaster } from "react-hot-toast";
import { Sidebar } from "./components/Sidebar";
import { Header } from "./components/Header";
import { FleetOverviewTab } from "./components/tabs/FleetOverviewTab";
import { EngineDetailTab } from "./components/tabs/EngineDetailTab";
import { WorkOrdersTab } from "./components/tabs/WorkOrdersTab";
import { ModelLabTab } from "./components/tabs/ModelLabTab";
import { CostSimulatorTab } from "./components/tabs/CostSimulatorTab";
import { MLOpsTab } from "./components/tabs/MLOpsTab";
import { DataPipelineTab } from "./components/tabs/DataPipelineTab";
import { HowItWorksTab } from "./components/tabs/HowItWorksTab";
import { DiagnosticPanel } from "./components/DiagnosticPanel";
import { ErrorBoundary } from "./components/ErrorBoundary";

export function App() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>("fleet");
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [currentSubset, setCurrentSubset] = useState<string>("FD001");
  const [selectedEngineId, setSelectedEngineId] = useState<string>("FD001-001");

  // Replay & Telemetry state
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState<number>(1);
  const [currentCycle, setCurrentCycle] = useState<number>(30);
  const [wsConnected, setWsConnected] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Data cache
  const [fleetData, setFleetData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [recentAlerts, setRecentAlerts] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const wsRef = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null);

  // Fetch Fleet summary
  const fetchFleet = () => {
    fetch(`/api/v1/fleet?subset=${currentSubset}`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
        setFleetData(data);
        if (data.engines && data.engines.length > 0 && !selectedEngineId) {
          setSelectedEngineId(data.engines[0].engine_id);
        }
      })
      .catch((err) => console.log("Waiting for backend API..."));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFleet();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchFleet, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [currentSubset]);

  // WebSocket Connection
  useEffect(() => {
    const protocol = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss:" : "ws:";
    const host = window.location.host;
    const wsUrl = `${protocol}//${host}/ws`;

    const connectWs = () => {
      const socket = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
      wsRef.current = socket;

      socket.onopen = () => {
        setWsConnected(true);
      };

      socket.onmessage = (event) => {
        try {
          const msg = JSON.parse(event.data);
          if (msg.type === "tick") {
            setCurrentCycle(msg.data.cycle || 30);
            if (msg.data.order) {
              setRecentAlerts((prev) => [msg.data.order, ...prev.slice(0, 30)]);
            }
          } else if (msg.type === "work_order_created") {
            setRecentAlerts((prev) => [msg.data, ...prev.slice(0, 30)]);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
      };

      socket.onclose = () => {
        setWsConnected(false);
        setTimeout(connectWs, 3000);
      };

      socket.onerror = () => {
        socket.close();
      };
    };

    connectWs();
    return () => {
      if (wsRef.current) wsRef.current.close();
    };
  }, []);

  // Play / Pause / Speed Replay Handlers
  const handleTogglePlay = async () => {
    const nextState = !isPlaying;
    setIsPlaying(nextState);
    if (nextState) {
      await fetch(`/api/v1/replay/start?speed=${speed}`, { method: "POST" });
    } else {
      await fetch(`/api/v1/replay/pause`, { method: "POST" });
    }
  };

  const handleChangeSpeed = async (newSpeed: number) => {
    setSpeed(newSpeed);
    if (isPlaying) {
      await fetch(`/api/v1/replay/start?speed=${newSpeed}`, { method: "POST" });
    }
  };

  const handleReset = async () => {
    setIsPlaying(false);
    await fetch(`/api/v1/replay/reset`, { method: "POST" });
    setCurrentCycle(20);
    fetchFleet();
  };

  const handleLifecycleDemo = async () => {
    // 1-Click Lifecycle Demo Story
    setIsPlaying(true);
    setSpeed(5);
    setActiveTab("engine");
    setSelectedEngineId(`${currentSubset}-001`);
    await fetch(`/api/v1/replay/start?speed=5&mode=lifecycle_demo&unit=1`, { method: "POST" });
  };

  const handleSelectEngine = (engineId: string) => {
    setSelectedEngineId(engineId);
    setActiveTab("engine");
  };

  const exceptionCount = fleetData?.kpis?.exception_queue_size || 0;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#090a10] text-[#f8fafc] flex">
      {/* Collapsible Sidebar */}
      <Sidebar
        activeTab={activeTab}
        setActiveTab={setActiveTab}
        collapsed={collapsed}
        setCollapsed={setCollapsed}
        exceptionCount={exceptionCount}
      />

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <div 
        className={`flex-1 transition-all duration-300 main-mesh min-h-screen flex flex-col ${
          collapsed ? "ml-20" : "ml-72"
        }`}
      >
        {/* Sticky Header with Replay Controls */}
        <Header
          currentSubset={currentSubset}
          onSelectSubset={(sub) => {
            setCurrentSubset(sub);
            setSelectedEngineId(`${sub}-001`);
          }}
          isPlaying={isPlaying}
          onTogglePlay={handleTogglePlay}
          speed={speed}
          onChangeSpeed={handleChangeSpeed}
          onReset={handleReset}
          onLifecycleDemo={handleLifecycleDemo}
          currentCycle={currentCycle}
          wsConnected={wsConnected}
        />

        {/* Dynamic Tab Body */}
        <main className="flex-1 p-8 overflow-y-auto">
          {activeTab === "fleet" && (
            <ErrorBoundary fallbackTitle="Fleet Overview">
              <FleetOverviewTab
                fleetData={fleetData}
                onSelectEngine={handleSelectEngine}
                recentAlerts={recentAlerts}
              />
            </ErrorBoundary>
          )}

          {activeTab === "engine" && (
            <ErrorBoundary fallbackTitle="Engine Telemetry View">
              <EngineDetailTab
                selectedEngineId={selectedEngineId}
                currentSubset={currentSubset}
                onBackToFleet={() => setActiveTab("fleet")}
              />
            </ErrorBoundary>
          )}

          {activeTab === "work_orders" && (
            <WorkOrdersTab currentSubset={currentSubset} />
          )}

          {activeTab === "cost_simulator" && (
            <CostSimulatorTab currentSubset={currentSubset} />
          )}

          {activeTab === "model_lab" && (
            <ModelLabTab />
          )}

          {activeTab === "mlops" && (
            <MLOpsTab currentSubset={currentSubset} />
          )}

          {activeTab === "pipeline" && (
            <DataPipelineTab currentSubset={currentSubset} />
          )}

          {activeTab === "how_it_works" && (
            <HowItWorksTab />
          )}
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* Fleet Diagnostic Panel & Grok Bot Copilot */}
      <DiagnosticPanel
        currentSubset={currentSubset}
        currentCycle={currentCycle}
        isPlaying={isPlaying}
        exceptionCount={fleetData?.exception_count || 0}
        wsConnected={wsConnected}
        fleetData={fleetData}
        recentAlerts={recentAlerts}
        onSelectEngine={handleSelectEngine}
      />

      <Toaster 
        position="top-right" 
        toastOptions={{
          style: {
            background: "#0f172a",
            color: "#f8fafc",
            border: "1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3)",
            fontSize: "12px",
            borderRadius: "1rem"
          }
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { createAvatar, type AvatarController } from "@bible-strong/avatar-react";
import "@bible-strong/avatar-react/styles.css";
import { 
  Activity, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  ChevronDown, 
  ChevronUp, 
  Radio, 
  Clock, 
  Wrench, 
  Volume2, 
  VolumeX, 
  Send, 
  Sparkles, 
  RefreshCw, 
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldCheck
} from "lucide-react";
import grokAvatarDefinition from "../assets/grok-bot.avatar.json";

// Create concrete avatar component from definition
const GrokAvatar = createAvatar(grokAvatarDefinition as any);

type AnimationName = 
  | "sleeping" 
  | "waking" 
  | "idle" 
  | "listening" 
  | "thinking" 
  | "searching" 
  | "working" 
  | "excited" 
  | "bored" 
  | "suspicious" 
  | "angry" 
  | "drowsy" 
  | "happy" 
  | "celebrate";

interface DiagnosticPanelProps {
  currentSubset: string;
  currentCycle: number;
  isPlaying: boolean;
  exceptionCount: number;
  wsConnected: boolean;
  fleetData?: any;
  recentAlerts?: any[];
  onSelectEngine?: (engineId: string) => void;
}

interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  sender: "user" | "grok";
  text: string;
  bullets?: string[];
  engineId?: string;
  severity?: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

export const DiagnosticPanel: React.FC<DiagnosticPanelProps> = ({
  currentSubset,
  currentCycle,
  isPlaying,
  exceptionCount,
  wsConnected,
  fleetData,
  recentAlerts = [],
  onSelectEngine
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<"qa" | "diagnostics">("qa");
  const [currentAnimation, setCurrentAnimation] = useState<AnimationName>("idle");
  const [manualOverride, setManualOverride] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [voiceEnabled, setVoiceEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [inputQuery, setInputQuery] = useState<string>("");
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const avatarRef = useRef<AvatarController | null>(null);
  const chatScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Derived metrics from fleet data
  const engines = fleetData?.engines || [];
  const totalEngines = fleetData?.total_engines || engines.length || 0;
  const criticalEngines = engines.filter((e: any) => e.severity === "CRITICAL");
  const highEngines = engines.filter((e: any) => e.severity === "HIGH");
  const criticalCount = fleetData?.critical_count || criticalEngines.length || 0;
  const highCount = highEngines.length;
  const mediumCount = engines.filter((e: any) => e.severity === "MEDIUM").length;
  const healthyCount = engines.filter((e: any) => e.severity === "HEALTHY" || e.severity === "LOW").length;
  const openOrdersCount = fleetData?.open_work_orders ?? engines.filter((e: any) => e.has_open_order).length ?? 0;
  const avgRul = fleetData?.avg_rul ?? (engines.length > 0 
    ? (engines.reduce((acc: number, e: any) => acc + (e.conservative_rul || 0), 0) / engines.length).toFixed(1) 
    : "—");

  const sampleCriticalEngine = criticalEngines[0] || highEngines[0] || engines[0] || { engine_id: `${currentSubset}-042` };

  // Initial chat history
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([
    {
      id: "intro-1",
      sender: "grok",
      text: "AETURNUS Flight Copilot online with 3D Grok Avatar. Telemetry stream locked. Click a quick prompt or query any turbofan engine for root-cause diagnosis.",
      timestamp: "System Ready"
    }
  ]);

  // Trigger avatar animation
  const triggerAnimation = (anim: AnimationName, durationMs: number = 3500) => {
    setCurrentAnimation(anim);
    setManualOverride(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setManualOverride(false);
      setCurrentAnimation(criticalCount > 0 ? "angry" : "idle");
    }, durationMs);
  };

  // Audio / Speech Synthesis (Avionics chime + Web Speech API)
  const playCockpitChime = () => {
    try {
      const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AudioCtx) return;
      const ctx = new AudioCtx();
      
      const now = ctx.currentTime;
      const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
      const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();

      osc1.type = "sine";
      osc2.type = "triangle";

      // Avionics dual tone alert (880Hz -> 659.25Hz)
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, now);
      osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(659.25, now + 0.18);
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, now);
      osc2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(329.63, now + 0.18);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.45);

      osc1.connect(gain);
      osc2.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc1.start(now);
      osc2.start(now);
      osc1.stop(now + 0.45);
      osc2.stop(now + 0.45);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Web Audio not allowed or unavailable", e);
    }
  };

  const speakCockpitWarning = (text: string) => {
    if (!voiceEnabled || !window.speechSynthesis) return;
    try {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      playCockpitChime();
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
        utterance.rate = 1.05;
        utterance.pitch = 1.0;
        setCurrentAnimation("excited");
        utterance.onend = () => {
          if (!manualOverride) {
            setCurrentAnimation(criticalCount > 0 ? "angry" : "idle");
          }
        };
        utterance.onerror = () => {
          if (!manualOverride) {
            setCurrentAnimation(criticalCount > 0 ? "angry" : "idle");
          }
        };
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
      }, 300);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Speech synthesis failed", err);
    }
  };

  // Announce incoming critical alarms
  const lastAlertIdRef = useRef<string>("");
  useEffect(() => {
    if (recentAlerts.length > 0 && voiceEnabled) {
      const top = recentAlerts[0];
      const alertKey = `${top.engine_id}-${top.severity}-${top.cycle}`;
      if (top.severity === "CRITICAL" && alertKey !== lastAlertIdRef.current) {
        lastAlertIdRef.current = alertKey;
        setCurrentAnimation("angry");
        speakCockpitWarning(`Master Warning. Critical severity detected on Turbofan Unit ${top.engine_id}. Remaining useful life under 15 cycles.`);
      }
    }
  }, [recentAlerts, voiceEnabled]);

  // Expression updates based on fleet state
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!manualOverride && !isProcessing) {
      if (criticalCount > 0) {
        setCurrentAnimation("angry");
      } else {
        setCurrentAnimation("idle");
      }
    }
  }, [criticalCount, manualOverride, isProcessing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatScrollRef.current) {
      chatScrollRef.current.scrollTop = chatScrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [messages, isProcessing]);

  // Handle Q&A Queries
  const handleQuery = async (queryText: string) => {
    if (!queryText.trim() || isProcessing) return;

    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
      sender: "user",
      text: queryText,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' })
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setInputQuery("");
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setCurrentAnimation("thinking");

    const lower = queryText.toLowerCase();

    try {
      // 1. "Which engines are in danger today?"
      if (lower.includes("in danger") || lower.includes("danger") || lower.includes("critical")) {
        const critList = engines.filter((e: any) => e.severity === "CRITICAL");
        const highList = engines.filter((e: any) => e.severity === "HIGH");

        setTimeout(() => {
          let replyText = "";
          let bullets: string[] = [];
          if (critList.length === 0 && highList.length === 0) {
            replyText = "All fleet engines are operating nominally. No critical degradation detected.";
            bullets = [
              `Fleet Size: ${totalEngines} active turbofan units`,
              `Average RUL: ${avgRul} cycles across ${currentSubset}`,
              `Zero engines currently breached the 30-cycle alert threshold`
            ];
            setCurrentAnimation("happy");
          } else {
            replyText = `Identified ${critList.length} CRITICAL and ${highList.length} HIGH severity engines requiring intervention:`;
            bullets = [
              ...critList.slice(0, 3).map((e: any) => 
                `CRITICAL Unit ${e.engine_id}: RUL = ${e.conservative_rul} cycles (p10 envelope). Suspected Subsystem: ${e.suspected_subsystem || "HPC Compressor"}. Rule M1/M2/M3 triggered.`
              ),
              ...highList.slice(0, 2).map((e: any) => 
                `HIGH Unit ${e.engine_id}: RUL = ${e.conservative_rul} cycles. Prioritized for scheduled inspection.`
              )
            ];
            setCurrentAnimation("angry");
            if (critList.length > 0) {
              speakCockpitWarning(`Alert: ${critList.length} critical turbofan engines detected in fleet. Unit ${critList[0].engine_id} has conservative life of ${critList[0].conservative_rul} cycles.`);
            }
          }

          setMessages((prev) => [
            ...prev,
            {
              id: `grok-${Date.now()}`,
              sender: "grok",
              text: replyText,
              bullets,
              engineId: critList[0]?.engine_id,
              severity: critList.length > 0 ? "CRITICAL" : "HEALTHY",
              timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' })
            }
          ]);
          setIsProcessing(false);
        }, 700);
        return;
      }

      // 2. Specific engine inquiry or general root cause
      const engineMatch = lower.match(/(engine|unit)\s*#?([a-z0-9_-]+)/i);
      const targetEngineId = engineMatch ? engineMatch[2].toUpperCase() : (sampleCriticalEngine?.engine_id || `${currentSubset}-001`);
      const normalizedTarget = targetEngineId.includes("-") ? targetEngineId : `${currentSubset}-${targetEngineId.padStart(3, "0")}`;

      // Fetch live engine telemetry from API
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/engines/${normalizedTarget}?subset=${currentSubset}`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        const pred = data.prediction || {};
        const shapBars = data.shapBars || data.shap_bars || [];
        const topDev = shapBars[0] || { sensor: "s9", name: "HPC Outflow", subsystem: "HPC" };
        const consRul = pred.conservative_rul ?? 12;

        const explanation = `Diagnostics for Turbofan Unit ${data.engine_id} (Cycle ${data.current_cycle}):`;
        const bullets = [
          `Remaining Useful Life: Conservative p10 = ${consRul} cycles (Envelope: [${pred.rul_p10 ?? 10} - ${pred.rul_p90 ?? 18}]).`,
          `Primary Degradation Driver: ${topDev.sensor} (${topDev.name}) attributed to ${topDev.subsystem || "HPC Compressor"}. Deviation exceeds healthy baseline.`,
          `Continuous Health Index: Monotonically tracked to ${(pred.health_index ?? 0.28).toFixed(2)} with Anomaly Score = ${(pred.anomaly_score ?? 0.88).toFixed(2)}.`,
          `Maintenance Recommendation: Triage rule triggered. Escalate to priority maintenance queue for borescope inspection of ${topDev.subsystem || "HPC Compressor"}.`
        ];

        if (consRul <= 15) {
          setCurrentAnimation("angry");
          speakCockpitWarning(`Warning. Engine ${data.engine_id} is critical. Degradation driven by ${topDev.subsystem || "HPC"}. Priority queue escalation advised.`);
        } else {
          setCurrentAnimation("working");
        }

        setMessages((prev) => [
          ...prev,
          {
            id: `grok-${Date.now()}`,
            sender: "grok",
            text: explanation,
            bullets,
            engineId: data.engine_id,
            severity: consRul <= 15 ? "CRITICAL" : "HIGH",
            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' })
          }
        ]);
      } else {
        // Fallback for general engines from fleet summary
        setCurrentAnimation("searching");
        setMessages((prev) => [
          ...prev,
          {
            id: `grok-${Date.now()}`,
            sender: "grok",
            text: `Telemetry analysis for ${sampleCriticalEngine?.engine_id || "Active Fleet Engine"}:`,
            bullets: [
              `Conservative RUL floor: ${sampleCriticalEngine?.conservative_rul || 14} cycles.`,
              `Suspected Subsystem: ${sampleCriticalEngine?.suspected_subsystem || "High-Pressure Compressor (HPC)"}.`,
              `Priority Score: Ranked by weighted formula (RUL, failure probability, anomaly score, drift).`,
              `Triage Status: Rule M1/M2/M3 evaluated against calibrated conformal bounds.`
            ],
            engineId: sampleCriticalEngine?.engine_id,
            severity: sampleCriticalEngine?.severity || "CRITICAL",
            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' })
          }
        ]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          id: `grok-${Date.now()}`,
          sender: "grok",
          text: `Telemetry triage complete for ${currentSubset}. Fleet operating at ${avgRul} average cycles with ${criticalCount} critical alerts.`,
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' })
        }
      ]);
      setCurrentAnimation("idle");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // Quick Prompt Chips
  const quickPrompts = [
    { label: "🚨 Which engines are in danger today?", query: "Which engines are in danger today?" },
    { label: `🔍 Why is Engine ${sampleCriticalEngine?.engine_id || '#42'} critical?`, query: `Why is Engine ${sampleCriticalEngine?.engine_id || '#42'} critical?` },
    { label: "⚡ Priority maintenance ranking", query: "What engines are prioritized in the maintenance queue?" },
    { label: "📊 Fleet telemetry health summary", query: "Summarize the fleet health telemetry and RUL" }
  ];

  const animationsList: AnimationName[] = [
    "idle", "thinking", "searching", "working", "excited", 
    "happy", "angry", "suspicious", "celebrate"
  ];

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-40 flex flex-col items-end">
      {/* Expanded Interactive Copilot Drawer */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="mb-3 w-84 sm:w-[420px] rounded-3xl bg-[#0b0d17]/95 border border-indigo-500/30 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl p-5 space-y-4 text-xs animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-200 text-slate-200">
          {/* Header & Avatar Visualizer */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-indigo-500/20 pb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              {/* 3D Grok Avatar in Header */}
              <div 
                onClick={() => triggerAnimation("excited", 3000)}
                className="relative w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 border border-indigo-500/40 shadow-inner overflow-hidden cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
                title="Click Grok Avatar to interact"
              >
                <GrokAvatar
                  ref={avatarRef}
                  animation={currentAnimation}
                  size={46}
                  className="pointer-events-none drop-shadow-md"
                />
                <span className={`absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${
                  currentAnimation === "angry" ? "bg-rose-500 animate-ping" : currentAnimation === "excited" ? "bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" : "bg-cyan-400"
                }`} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white tracking-wide">Grok Bot Copilot</span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono font-bold bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/40 capitalize">
                    {currentAnimation}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${wsConnected ? "bg-emerald-400" : "bg-amber-400"}`} />
                  <span>{currentSubset} Telemetry · Cycle {currentCycle}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Audio Toggle & Close Button */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => {

========== D:\Projects\SelfHealingMachines\web\src\components\ErrorBoundary.tsx ==========

import React, { Component, type ErrorInfo, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallbackTitle?: string;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error?: Error;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  public state: State = {
    hasError: false
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error("Uncaught tab error:", error, errorInfo);
  }

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="glass-panel p-8 rounded-3xl border-rose-500/30 text-center space-y-4 max-w-lg mx-auto my-12">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">
            {this.props.fallbackTitle || "Telemetry Component Error"}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">
            {this.state.error?.message || "Render exception trapped."}
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false })}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Reload Component</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

                isActive
                  ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600/30 to-purple-600/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/10"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800/40"
              }`}
            >
              <Icon className={`w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110 ${isActive ? "text-indigo-400" : "text-slate-400"}`} />
              {!collapsed && (
                <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>
                  {item.badge && (
                    <span className={`text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold ${
                      item.badgeAlert
                        ? "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30 animate-pulse"
                        : isActive 
                        ? "bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30" 
                        : "bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-700/50"
                    }`}>
                      {item.badge}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Footer System Status */}
      {!collapsed && (
        <div className="p-4 m-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-indigo-500/15">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse"></span>
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">Rule-Based Triage (No-LLM)</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
            <span>Deterministic Policy · v2026-10-07</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </aside>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import toast from "react-hot-toast";
import { 
  DollarSign, 
  TrendingUp, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Sliders, 
  Zap, 
  Plane, 
  ArrowRight, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  RefreshCw, 
  PieChart as PieIcon, 
  BarChart3, 
  Info,
  Scale,
  Sparkles,
  FileSpreadsheet
} from "lucide-react";
import { 
  ResponsiveContainer, 
  LineChart, 
  Line, 
  XAxis, 
  YAxis, 
  Tooltip, 
  CartesianGrid, 
  ReferenceLine, 
  Legend, 
  BarChart, 
  Bar, 
  Cell 
} from "recharts";

interface CostSimulatorTabProps {
  currentSubset: string;
}

export const CostSimulatorTab: React.FC<CostSimulatorTabProps> = ({ currentSubset }) => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [curveLoading, setCurveLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  
  // Interactive Simulation Parameters
  const [threshold, setThreshold] = useState<number>(30);
  const [useConservative, setUseConservative] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [costCatastrophic, setCostCatastrophic] = useState<number>(2500000);
  const [costOverhaul, setCostOverhaul] = useState<number>(220000);
  const [costWastedCycle, setCostWastedCycle] = useState<number>(1200);
  const [costInspection, setCostInspection] = useState<number>(12500);

  // Results State
  const [simData, setSimData] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [curveData, setCurveData] = useState<any | null>(null);

  // Fetch simulation
  const fetchSimulation = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const payload = {
      subset: currentSubset,
      threshold,
      use_conservative: useConservative,
      cost_catastrophic: costCatastrophic,
      cost_overhaul: costOverhaul,
      cost_wasted_cycle: costWastedCycle,
      cost_inspection: costInspection
    };

    fetch("/api/v1/economics/simulate", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    })
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((data) => {
        setSimData(data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error("Simulation fetch error:", err);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  };

  // Fetch U-Curve
  const fetchCurve = () => {
    setCurveLoading(true);
    fetch(`/api/v1/economics/curve?subset=${currentSubset}&use_conservative=${useConservative}&min_threshold=5&max_threshold=60`)
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((data) => {
        setCurveData(data);
        setCurveLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error("Curve fetch error:", err);
        setCurveLoading(false);
      });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSimulation();
    fetchCurve();
  }, [currentSubset, useConservative]);

  const handleApplyPreset = (preset: "commercial" | "cargo" | "military") => {
    if (preset === "commercial") {
      setCostCatastrophic(3000000);
      setCostOverhaul(240000);
      setCostWastedCycle(1400);
      setCostInspection(15000);
      toast.success("Applied Commercial Airline Preset ($3.0M AOG, $240k Overhaul)");
    } else if (preset === "cargo") {
      setCostCatastrophic(2000000);
      setCostOverhaul(200000);
      setCostWastedCycle(1000);
      setCostInspection(10000);
      toast.success("Applied Cargo Operator Preset ($2.0M AOG, $200k Overhaul)");
    } else {
      setCostCatastrophic(4500000);
      setCostOverhaul(350000);
      setCostWastedCycle(2200);
      setCostInspection(25000);
      toast.success("Applied Military / Heavy Preset ($4.5M AOG, $350k Overhaul)");
    }
  };

  const summary = simData?.summary;
  const policies = simData?.policies;
  const breakdownChart = simData?.breakdown_chart || [];
  const ledger = simData?.ledger || [];
  const optimalTau = curveData?.optimal_threshold || 11;
  const curvePoints = curveData?.curve || [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Stale Artifact Warning Banner */}
      {simData?.stale && (
        <div className="bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
          <div className="text-xs space-y-0.5">
            <div className="font-bold text-amber-200">Artifact Stale Warning</div>
            <div>
              Simulation bundle hash on disk does not match run manifest. Run <code className="bg-black/30 px-1 py-0.5 rounded font-mono">make evaluate</code> to synchronize.
              {simData?.stale_reason && <span className="ml-1 text-amber-400/80">({simData.stale_reason})</span>}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Banner: Financial ROI Overview */}
      <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-emerald-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-1/3 w-80 h-80 bg-indigo-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-6 relative z-10">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400">
                <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
                Operational Cost &amp; Fleet Maintenance ROI Simulator
              </h2>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 font-bold">
                {currentSubset} Fleet Analytics
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-3xl leading-relaxed">
              Mathematical lifecycle economics modeling: compare unscheduled Aircraft on Ground (AOG) catastrophic failure penalties against AETURNUS conservative predictive maintenance dispatch and static overhaul policies.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button

                setThreshold(optimalTau);

            >
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />

Modify these inputs to reflect your fleet's actual contractual unit economics.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import toast from "react-hot-toast";
import { 
  Cpu, 
  TrendingDown, 
  Activity, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Clock, 
  Layers, 
  BarChart3,
  CheckCircle2,
  FileText,
  FileDown,
  Plane,
  PackageCheck,
  Wrench,
  Compass,
  Loader2
} from "lucide-react";
import { 
  ResponsiveContainer, 
  LineChart, 
  Line, 
  AreaChart, 
  Area, 
  XAxis, 
  YAxis, 
  Tooltip, 
  Legend, 
  CartesianGrid,
  ReferenceLine,
  RadarChart,
  Radar,
  PolarGrid,
  PolarAngleAxis,
  PolarRadiusAxis
} from "recharts";

interface EngineDetailTabProps {
  selectedEngineId: string;
  currentSubset: string;
  onBackToFleet: () => void;
}

export const EngineDetailTab: React.FC<EngineDetailTabProps> = ({
  selectedEngineId,
  currentSubset,
  onBackToFleet
}) => {
  const [engineData, setEngineData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [selectedSensor, setSelectedSensor] = useState<string>("s3"); // s3 is T30 (HPC temp)
  const [radarMode, setRadarMode] = useState<"degradation" | "health">("degradation");
  const [multiHorizonMode, setMultiHorizonMode] = useState<"stacked" | "cumulative">("stacked");
  const [isDownloadingPdf, setIsDownloadingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleDownloadPdf = async () => {
    if (isDownloadingPdf || !engineData?.engine_id) return;
    setIsDownloadingPdf(true);
    const toastId = toast.loading(`Generating Maintenance Report PDF for ${engineData.engine_id}...`);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/engines/${engineData.engine_id}/maintenance-report.pdf?subset=${currentSubset}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}: Failed to generate report`);
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `maintenance_report_${engineData.engine_id}_${currentSubset}.pdf`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      toast.success(`Maintenance Report PDF downloaded for ${engineData.engine_id}`, { id: toastId });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("PDF download failed:", err);
      toast.error(`Download failed: ${err.message || "Error generating report"}`, { id: toastId });
    } finally {
      setIsDownloadingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedEngineId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    fetch(`/api/v1/engines/${selectedEngineId}?subset=${currentSubset}`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
        setEngineData(data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error("Error fetching engine detail:", err);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [selectedEngineId, currentSubset]);

  const pred = engineData?.prediction || {};
  const trajectory = engineData?.trajectory || [];
  const shapBars = engineData?.shapBars || engineData?.shap_bars || [];
  const workOrder = engineData?.work_order;
  const isCritical = (pred.conservative_rul || 999) <= 15;

  const rawSubsystemHealth = engineData?.subsystem_health;
  const subsystemHealthData = useMemo(() => {
    if (rawSubsystemHealth && rawSubsystemHealth.length > 0) {
      return rawSubsystemHealth.map((s: any) => ({
        ...s,
        attribution_share: s.attribution_share !== undefined ? s.attribution_share : s.degradation,
        nominal_baseline: 20.0
      }));
    }
    const stations = ["Fan / LPC", "HPC", "Combustor", "HPT", "LPT / Exhaust"];
    return stations.map((sub) => ({
      subsystem: sub,
      attribution_share: 20.0,
      share: 20.0,
      degradation: 20.0,
      health: 80.0,
      baseline: 20.0,
      nominal_baseline: 20.0,
      status: "NOMINAL"
    }));
  }, [rawSubsystemHealth]);

  // Multi-Horizon Failure Probabilities Evolution (H=10, 30, 60)
  const multiHorizonData = useMemo(() => {
    return trajectory.map((pt: any) => {
      let p10 = pt.fail_prob_10;
      let p30 = pt.fail_prob_30;
      let p60 = pt.fail_prob_60;

      // Fallback calculation if not in telemetry point
      if (p10 === undefined || p30 === undefined || p60 === undefined) {
        const rul = pt.rul_p50 || 100;
        p10 = Number((1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp((rul - 10) / 4.0))).toFixed(3));
        p30 = Number((1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp((rul - 30) / 7.0))).toFixed(3));
        p60 = Number((1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp((rul - 60) / 12.0))).toFixed(3));
      }

      // Enforce monotonicity: p10 <= p30 <= p60
      p30 = Math.max(p10, p30);
      p60 = Math.max(p30, p60);

      const p30_inc = Math.max(0, p30 - p10);
      const p60_inc = Math.max(0, p60 - p30);
      const safe_margin = Math.max(0, 1.0 - p60);

      return {
        cycle: pt.cycle,
        p10_pct: Number((p10 * 100).toFixed(1)),
        p30_pct: Number((p30 * 100).toFixed(1)),
        p60_pct: Number((p60 * 100).toFixed(1)),
        p10_inc_pct: Number((p10 * 100).toFixed(1)),
        p30_inc_pct: Number((p30_inc * 100).toFixed(1)),
        p60_inc_pct: Number((p60_inc * 100).toFixed(1)),
        safe_pct: Number((safe_margin * 100).toFixed(1)),
        true_rul: pt.true_rul
      };
    });
  }, [trajectory]);

  const latestP10 = pred.fail_prob_10 !== undefined ? (pred.fail_prob_10 * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0";
  const latestP30 = pred.fail_prob_30 !== undefined ? (pred.fail_prob_30 * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0";
  const latestP60 = pred.fail_prob_60 !== undefined ? (pred.fail_prob_60 * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0";
  const threshold30 = pred.classifier_threshold_30 !== undefined ? (pred.classifier_threshold_30 * 100).toFixed(0) : "70";
  const isRuleM3Fired = Number(latestP30) >= Number(threshold30);

  if (loading || !engineData) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-96">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-400">
          <Activity className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-indigo-400" />
          <span>Loading telemetry curves for {selectedEngineId}...</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top Banner & Quick Controls */}
      <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-indigo-500/25">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30">
            <Cpu className="w-7 h-7 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black font-mono text-white tracking-tight">
                {engineData.engine_id}
              </h2>
              <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full font-mono bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30">
                Regime #{engineData.regime}
              </span>
              <span className={`text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${
                pred.conservative_rul <= 15 ? "badge-critical" : pred.conservative_rul <= 30 ? "badge-high" : "badge-healthy"
              }`}>
                {pred.conservative_rul <= 15 ? "CRITICAL" : pred.conservative_rul <= 30 ? "HIGH" : "HEALTHY"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
              Turbofan Unit {engineData.unit} · Current Replay Cycle: <span className="text-cyan-300 font-mono font-bold">{engineData.current_cycle}</span> · Suspected Subsystem: <span className="text-purple-300 font-semibold">{shapBars[0]?.subsystem || "HPC"}</span>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Prediction Summary & One-Click PDF Download */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
            <div className="text-right">
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Conservative RUL (p10)</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black font-mono text-white flex items-baseline justify-end gap-1">
                <span>{pred.conservative_rul}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-normal">cycles</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="h-10 w-px bg-slate-800"></div>
            <div className="text-right">
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Uncertainty Envelope</div>
              <div className="text-xs font-mono text-cyan-300">
                [{pred.rul_p10} - {pred.rul_p90}]
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">p10 to p90 interval</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleDownloadPdf}
            disabled={isDownloadingPdf}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600/30 hover:bg-indigo-600/50 border border-indigo-500/40 text-indigo-200 text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-md group disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {isDownloadingPdf ? (
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-indigo-300" />
            ) : (
              <FileDown className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-300 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
            )}
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">
              {isDownloadingPdf ? "Generating PDF..." : "Maintenance Report PDF"}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Charts: 1. RUL Prediction vs Ground Truth & 2. Health Index Degradation */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        {/* RUL Prediction Curve with Confidence Envelope */}
        <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" />
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">Remaining Useful Life (RUL) Trajectory</h3>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px]">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-indigo-400">
                <span className="w-3 h-0.5 bg-indigo-400 inline-block"></span> p50 Median
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-400">
                <span className="w-3 h-0.5 bg-emerald-400 inline-block"></span> Ground Truth
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            Shaded blue envelope represents 80% confidence interval [p10–p90]. Model tracks linear degradation.
          </p>

          <div className="h-72 w-full pt-2">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <AreaChart data={trajectory}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1f2937" vertical={false} />
                <XAxis dataKey="cycle" stroke="#6b7280" fontSize={11} tickLine={false} />
                <YAxis stroke="#6b7280" fontSize={11} tickLine={false} domain={[0, 'auto']} />
                <Tooltip 
                  contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: "#0f172a", borderColor: "#374151", borderRadius: "12px", fontSize: "12px" }}
                />
                <Area 
                  type="monotone" 
                  dataKey="rul_p90" 
                  stroke="none" 
                  fill="#6366f1" 
                  fillOpacity={0.15} 
                  name="Uncertainty Band (p90)"
                />
                <Area 
                  type="monotone" 
                  dataKey="rul_p10" 
                  stroke="none" 
                  fill="#090a10" 
                  fillOpacity={1.0} 
                  name="Uncertainty Floor (p10)"
                />
                <Line 
                  type="monotone" 
                  dataKey="rul_p50" 
                  stroke="#818cf8" 
                  strokeWidth={2.5} 
                  dot={false} 
                  name="Predicted RUL (p50)"
                />
                <Line 
                  type="monotone" 
                  dataKey="true_rul" 
                  stroke="#34d399" 
                  strokeWidth={2} 
                  strokeDasharray="4 4" 
                  dot={false} 
                  name="Ground Truth RUL"
                />
              </AreaChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Health Index (0-1) & Anomaly Onset */}
        <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-400" />
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">Continuous Health Index (HI) &amp; Anomaly Onset</h3>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px]">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-cyan-400">
                <span className="w-3 h-0.5 bg-cyan-400 inline-block"></span> Health Index (0-1)
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-rose-400">
                <span className="w-3 h-0.5 bg-rose-400 inline-block"></span> Anomaly Score
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            PCA projection smoothed monotonically. Degradation onset flagged when Health Index deviates &gt; 3-sigma.
          </p>

          <div className="h-72 w-full pt-2">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <LineChart data={trajectory}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1f2937" vertical={false} />
                <XAxis dataKey="cycle" stroke="#6b7280" fontSize={11} tickLine={false} />
                <YAxis stroke="#6b7280" fontSize={11} tickLine={false} domain={[0, 1]} />
                <Tooltip 
                  contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: "#0f172a", borderColor: "#374151", borderRadius: "12px", fontSize: "12px" }}
                />
                <Line 
                  type="monotone" 
                  dataKey="health_index" 
                  stroke="#06b6d4" 
                  strokeWidth={2.5} 
                  dot={false} 
                  name="Health Index (HI)"
                />
                <Line 
                  type="monotone" 
                  dataKey="anomaly_score" 
                  stroke="#fb7185" 
                  strokeWidth={2} 
                  dot={false} 
                  name="Isolation Forest Anomaly"
                />
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Multi-Horizon Failure Probability Stacked Area Chart (H=10, 30, 60) */}
      <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl space-y-4 border-indigo-500/20">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-400">
              <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">Multi-Horizon Failure Probability Evolution</h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/20 uppercase font-bold">
                  H = 10, 30, 60 Cycles
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                Probability of uncommanded failure across distinct dispatch windows as telemetry degrades toward end-of-life.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Mode Switcher & M3 Rule Badge */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto">
            {isRuleM3Fired && (
              <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center gap-1 animate-pulse">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-400" />
                Rule M3 Active (P₃₀ ≥ τ₃₀)
              </span>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-900/80 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <button
                onClick={() => setMultiHorizonMode("stacked")}
                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg transition-all font-medium ${
                  multiHorizonMode === "stacked"
                    ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30"
                    : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
                }`}
              >
                Stacked Risk Windows
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setMultiHorizonMode("cumulative")}
                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg transition-all font-medium ${
                  multiHorizonMode === "cumulative"
                    ? "bg-purple-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-md shadow-purple-600/30"
                    : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
                }`}
              >
                Cumulative Horizons
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Multi-Horizon KPI Strip */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          {/* H = 10 */}
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-rose-500/20">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-300 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">H = 10 Cycles</span>
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500"></span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold text-rose-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{latestP10}%</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">Immediate Critical Hazard</div>
          </div>

          {/* H = 30 */}
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/20">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-300 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">H = 30 Cycles</span>
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold text-amber-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{latestP30}%</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">Triage Threshold: {threshold30}%</div>
          </div>

          {/* H = 60 */}
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-indigo-500/20">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-300 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">H = 60 Cycles</span>
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-500"></span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold text-indigo-300 font-mono mt-0.5">{latestP60}%</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">Early Advisory Horizon</div>
          </div>

          {/* Action Trigger */}
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">Triage Trigger</span>
              <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${isRuleM3Fired ? "bg-amber-400 animate-ping" : "bg-emerald-400"}`}></span>
            </div>
            <div className={`text-sm font-bold font-mono mt-1 ${isRuleM3Fired ? "text-amber-300" : "text-emerald-400"}`}>
              {isRuleM3Fired ? "Escalated: Order Dispatched" : "Nominal: Standard Watch"}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono truncate">Rule M3: P(fail ≤ 30) ≥ τ₃₀</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Stacked / Cumulative Area Chart */}
        <div className="h-72 w-full pt-2">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <AreaChart data={multiHorizonData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 20, bottom: 20, left: 0 }}>
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="p10Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#f43f5e" stopOpacity={0.7} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#f43f5e" stopOpacity={0.2} />
                </linearGradient>
                <linearGradient id="p30Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#f97316" stopOpacity={0.65} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#f97316" stopOpacity={0.15} />
                </linearGradient>
                <linearGradient id="p60Grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#818cf8" stopOpacity={0.55} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#818cf8" stopOpacity={0.1} />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1e293b" />
              <XAxis 
                dataKey="cycle" 
                stroke="#64748b" 
                fontSize={11} 
                tickLine={false}
                label={{ value: "Operating Engine Flight Cycle", position: "insideBottom", offset: -12, fill: "#94a3b8", fontSize: 11 }}
              />
              <YAxis 
                domain={[0, 100]} 
                stroke="#64748b" 
                fontSize={11} 
                tickLine={false} 
                unit="%" 
              />
              <Tooltip
                content={({ active, payload }) => {
                  if (active && payload && payload.length) {
                    const d = payload[0].payload;
                    return (
                      <div className="bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-700/80 p-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-xl text-xs space-y-2 min-w-[220px]">
                        <div className="font-bold text-white border-b border-slate-800 pb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span>Flight Cycle {d.cycle}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">RUL: {d.true_rul} cyc</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="space-y-1 font-mono text-[11px]">
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-rose-300">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-sans">
                              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500"></span>
                              H = 10 cyc:
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-bold">{d.p10_pct}%</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-amber-300">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-sans">
                              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></span>
                              H = 30 cyc:
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-bold">{d.p30_pct}%</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-indigo-300">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-sans">
                              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-400"></span>
                              H = 60 cyc:
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-bold">{d.p60_pct}%</span>
                          </div>
                          {multiHorizonMode === "stacked" && (
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-slate-400 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-[10px]">
                              <span className="font-sans">Safe Operating Reserve (&gt;60):</span>
                              <span>{d.safe_pct}%</span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  }
                  return null;
                }}
              />
              {/* Validation tuned threshold reference line */}
              <ReferenceLine 
                y={Number(threshold30)} 
                stroke="#f59e0b" 
                strokeDasharray="4 4" 
                strokeWidth={1.5}
                label={{ 
                  value: `τ₃₀ = ${threshold30}% Triage Threshold`, 
                  fill: "#fbbf24", 
                  fontSize: 10, 
                  position: "insideTopRight",
                  offset: 8 
                }} 
              />

              {multiHorizonMode === "stacked" ? (
                <>
                  <Area 
                    type="monotone" 
                    dataKey="p10_inc_pct" 
                    stackId="risk"
                    stroke="#f43f5e" 
                    strokeWidth={2} 
                    fill="url(#p10Grad)" 
                    name="Immediate Hazard (0-10 cyc)" 
                  />
                  <Area 
                    type="monotone" 
                    dataKey="p30_inc_pct" 
                    stackId="risk"
                    stroke="#f97316" 
                    strokeWidth={2} 
                    fill="url(#p30Grad)" 
                    name="Overhaul Window (10-30 cyc)" 
                  />
                  <Area 
                    type="monotone" 
                    dataKey="p60_inc_pct" 
                    stackId="risk"
                    stroke="#818cf8" 
                    strokeWidth={2} 
                    fill="url(#p60Grad)" 
                    name="Advisory Window (30-60 cyc)" 
                  />
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Area 
                    type="monotone" 
                    dataKey="p60_pct" 
                    stroke="#818cf8" 
                    strokeWidth={2} 
                    fill="url(#p60Grad)" 
                    name="P(fail ≤ 60 cyc)" 
                  />
                  <Area 
                    type="monotone" 
                    dataKey="p30_pct" 
                    stroke="#f97316" 
                    strokeWidth={2.5} 
                    fill="url(#p30Grad)" 
                    name="P(fail ≤ 30 cyc)" 
                  />
                  <Area 
                    type="monotone" 
                    dataKey="p10_pct" 
                    stroke="#f43f5e" 
                    strokeWidth={2.5} 
                    fill="url(#p10Grad)" 
                    name="P(fail ≤ 10 cyc)" 
                  />
                </>
              )}
            </AreaChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>

        {/* Legend Footnote */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 gap-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-rose-300">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500"></span>
              {multiHorizonMode === "stacked" ? "Critical (0-10 cyc)" : "P(fail ≤ 10)"}
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-300">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></span>
              {multiHorizonMode === "stacked" ? "Overhaul (10-30 cyc)" : "P(fail ≤ 30)"}
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-indigo-300">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-400"></span>
              {multiHorizonMode === "stacked" ? "Advisory (30-60 cyc)" : "P(fail ≤ 60)"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="font-mono text-slate-500 text-[10px]">
            Model: Multi-Horizon GBDT Classifiers with Monotone Risk Calibration
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 360° Gas-Path Attribution Share Radar */}
      <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl space-y-4 border-indigo-500/20">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/10 border border-purple-500/20 text-purple-400">

            </div>
            {subsystemHealthData.map((item: any, idx: number) => {
              const rank = item.driver_rank || (idx + 1);
              const isTop = rank === 1;
              const isSecond = rank === 2;
              const share = item.attribution_share !== undefined ? item.attribution_share : item.degradation;
              return (

              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">Sensor Telemetry (Raw vs Causal EWMA Filter)</h3>

              ].map((s) => (

                  key={s.id}

                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg transition-all font-medium ${
                    selectedSensor === s.id
                      ? "bg-purple-600 text-white font-semibold"
                      : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"

              <LineChart data={trajectory}>

                <XAxis dataKey="cycle" stroke="#6b7280" fontSize={11} tickLine={false} />

                  type="monotone"

                  stroke="#94a3b8" 
                  strokeWidth={1} 
                  dot={false} 
                  opacity={0.6}
                  name="Raw Sensor"
                />
                <Line 
                  type="monotone" 
                  dataKey={`${selectedSensor}_ewma`} 
                  stroke="#a855f7" 
                  strokeWidth={2.5} 
                  dot={false}

                />
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Explainability / SHAP Sensor Attribution & Multi-Horizon Risk (1 Col) */}
        <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl flex flex-col justify-between space-y-6">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <BarChart3 className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" />
                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">Top Contributing Sensors (SHAP)</h3>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-indigo-300 bg-indigo-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-indigo-500/20">
                TreeExplainer
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-3">
              Signed SHAP contributions to remaining life. Red accelerates degradation; blue indicates slower wear relative to baseline.
            </p>

            {/* Signed SHAP Bars */}
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {shapBars.map((item: any, idx: number) => {

                const absVal = Math.abs(item.shap_value !== undefined ? item.shap_value : (item.contribution || 0.1));
                const widthPct = Math.min(100, Math.max(12, absVal * 30));
                return (
                  <div key={idx} className="space-y-1 bg-slate-900/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-mono text-white font-bold">{item.sensor}</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">({item.name || item.sensor})</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-mono bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30">
                          {item.subsystem}
                        </span>
                        <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${
                          isShortening ? "text-rose-400" : "text-sky-400"
                        }`}>
                          {isShortening ? "Shortens Life" : "Prolongs Life"}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                      <div className="h-2 flex-1 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                        <div 
                          className={`h-full rounded-full ${
                            isShortening 
                              ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-rose-500" 
                              : "bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-500"
                          }`}
                          style={{ width: `${widthPct}%` }}
                        ></div>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-300 min-w-[42px] text-right">
                        {item.shap_value !== undefined ? (item.shap_value > 0 ? `+${item.shap_value.toFixed(2)}` : item.shap_value.toFixed(2)) : `${(item.contribution * 10).toFixed(2)}`}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Disclaimer */}
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 italic mt-3">
              {engineData.subsystem_disclaimer || "Subsystem mapping is an indicative association, not a diagnosis. For decision support only."}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Multi-Horizon Failure Risk */}
          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">Multi-Horizon Risk</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">Calibrated P(Fail ≤ H)</span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {[
                { label: "10 Cycles", prob: pred.fail_prob_10 ?? 0.05, thresh: 0.35 },
                { label: "30 Cycles", prob: pred.fail_prob_30 ?? 0.45, thresh: pred.classifier_threshold_30 ?? 0.50 },
                { label: "60 Cycles", prob: pred.fail_prob_60 ?? 0.85, thresh: 0.50 }
              ].map((h, i) => {
                const pct = Math.round(h.prob * 100);
                const isHigh = h.prob >= h.thresh;
                return (
                  <div key={i} className="bg-slate-900/90 p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center space-y-1">
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium">{h.label}</div>
                    <div className={`text-base font-black font-mono ${isHigh ? "text-rose-400" : "text-emerald-400"}`}>
                      {pct}%
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-500">
                      Thresh: {Math.round(h.thresh * 100)}%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Linked Work Order Snippet */}
          {workOrder && (
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Linked Work Order:</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-indigo-300 font-bold">{workOrder.work_order_id}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 bg-slate-900/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                {workOrder.recommended_action}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
