  const handleAdvance = async () => {
    if (!selectedOrder) return;
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/work-orders/${selectedOrder.work_order_id}/advance`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          note: actionReason
        })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.work_order) {
        setSelectedOrder(data.work_order);
      }
      fetchOrders();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error advancing lifecycle:", err);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const runWhatIf = async () => {
    if (isSimulating) return;
    setIsSimulating(true);
    const toastId = toast.loading(`Running What-If Policy Simulation on ${currentSubset}...`);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/rules/simulate?subset=${currentSubset}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          critical_threshold: simCrit,
          high_threshold: simHigh,
          anomaly_threshold: 0.80
        })
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}: Simulation error`);
      const data = await res.json();
      setSimResult(data);
      toast.success(
        `What-If Simulation Complete: ${data.total_simulated_orders} work orders evaluated across ${currentSubset}`,
        { id: toastId }
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Simulation failed:", err);
      toast.error(`Simulation failed: ${err.message || "Error running policy simulation"}`, { id: toastId });
    } finally {
      setIsSimulating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadWorkOrderPdf = async (wo: any) => {
    if (isDownloadingPdf || !wo) return;
    setIsDownloadingPdf(true);
    const toastId = toast.loading(`Generating Maintenance Report PDF for ${wo.work_order_id}...`);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/work-orders/${wo.work_order_id}/maintenance-report.pdf`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}: Failed to generate report`);
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `maintenance_report_${wo.work_order_id}.pdf`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      toast.success(`Maintenance Report PDF downloaded for ${wo.work_order_id}`, { id: toastId });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("PDF download error:", err);
      toast.error(`Download failed: ${err.message || "Error generating report"}`, { id: toastId });
    } finally {
      setIsDownloadingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  // Group into industrial lifecycle pipeline categories
  const proposedOrders = workOrders.filter(
    (o) => o.status === "PROPOSED" || o.status === "AUTO_CREATED"
  );
  const exceptionOrders = workOrders.filter((o) => o.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW");
  const logisticsOrders = workOrders.filter(
    (o) => o.status === "DISPATCHED" || o.status === "PARTS_ORDERED"
  );
  const maintenanceOrders = workOrders.filter(
    (o) => o.status === "IN_PROGRESS" || o.status === "APPROVED" || o.status === "OVERRIDDEN"
  );
  const closedOrders = workOrders.filter(
    (o) => o.status === "CLOSED" || o.status === "REJECTED"
  );

  const getStageIndex = (status: string) => {
    const idx = LIFECYCLE_STAGES.indexOf(status);
    if (idx !== -1) return idx;
    if (status === "AUTO_CREATED" || status === "NEEDS_REVIEW") return 0;
    if (status === "OVERRIDDEN") return 4;
    return -1;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header & Aerospace PdM KPIs Strip */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="glass-panel p-4 rounded-2xl">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">Total Work Orders</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-white mt-1">{workOrders.length}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Fleet-wide Requisition Pipeline</div>
        </div>

        <div className="glass-panel p-4 rounded-2xl border-amber-500/25">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300">Exception Queue (HITL)</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-amber-400 mt-1">{exceptionOrders.length}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-300/80 mt-0.5">Safety & Disagreement Triage</div>
        </div>

        <div className="glass-panel p-4 rounded-2xl border-indigo-500/25">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-300">Logistics & Hangar</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-indigo-400 mt-1">{logisticsOrders.length + maintenanceOrders.length}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-indigo-300/80 mt-0.5">Spares Dispatched / In-Work</div>
        </div>

        <div className="glass-panel p-4 rounded-2xl border-emerald-500/25">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300">Closed &amp; Resolved</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400 mt-1">{closedOrders.length}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 mt-0.5">Maintenance Signoff Completed</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Ranked Maintenance Priority Queue (Capacity-Constrained) */}
      <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl space-y-4 border-indigo-500/30">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Wrench className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">Ranked Maintenance Priority Queue</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                Composite urgency score $S_i$ ranked descending. Top {dailyCapacity} engines flagged as actionable today.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-900/90 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Daily Service Capacity:</span>
              <select
                value={dailyCapacity}
                onChange={(e) => setDailyCapacity(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="bg-slate-800 text-indigo-300 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-indigo-500/30 font-mono text-xs focus:outline-none"
              >
                <option value={3}>3 engines/shift</option>
                <option value={5}>5 engines/shift</option>
                <option value={8}>8 engines/shift</option>
                <option value={10}>10 engines/shift</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowQueue(!showQueue)}
              className="text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-medium transition-colors"
            >
              {showQueue ? "Collapse" : "Expand"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {showQueue && maintenanceQueue.length > 0 && (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-xs text-left">
              <thead className="bg-slate-900/80 text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold border-b border-slate-800">
                <tr>
                  <th className="p-3">Rank</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Engine ID</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Subsystem</th>
                  <th className="p-3 font-mono">Priority Score</th>
                  <th className="p-3 font-mono">RUL (p10)</th>
                  <th className="p-3 font-mono">P(Fail ≤ 30)</th>
                  <th className="p-3 font-mono">Anomaly Score</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-center">Shift Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-mono">
                {maintenanceQueue.map((item: any) => (
                  <tr 
                    key={item.rank}
                    className={`transition-colors ${
                      item.actionable_today ? "bg-emerald-950/15 hover:bg-emerald-950/25" : "hover:bg-slate-800/20 text-slate-400"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <td className="p-3 font-bold text-white">#{item.rank}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-bold text-cyan-300 font-mono">{item.engine_id}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-sans text-slate-300">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30 text-[10px]">
                        {item.suspected_subsystem}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-bold text-white">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span>{item.priority_score.toFixed(3)}</span>
                        <div className="w-16 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden hidden sm:block">
                          <div 
                            className="h-full bg-indigo-500 rounded-full" 
                            style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, item.priority_score * 100)}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-amber-300">{item.conservative_rul.toFixed(1)} cyc</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-rose-300">{(item.fail_prob_30 * 100).toFixed(0)}%</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-slate-300">{item.anomaly_score.toFixed(2)}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-center">
                      {item.actionable_today ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Actionable Today
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border border-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Backlog
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 italic">
          * Configured starting weights (w_rul=0.40, w_fail=0.30, w_anom=0.15, w_trend=0.15) for decision support, not empirical physical claims.
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Industrial Lifecycle Pipeline Kanban Board */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
        {/* Column 1: Proposed / Initial */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-indigo-500/20">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-400"></span>
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">1. Proposed</h3>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-indigo-400 bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-indigo-500/30">
              {proposedOrders.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[550px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {proposedOrders.map((order) => (
              <div 
                key={order.work_order_id} 
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(order)}
                className="glass-panel p-4 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer hover:border-indigo-500/50 transition-all space-y-2 group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-white group-hover:text-indigo-300">
                    {order.engine_id}
                  </span>
                  <span className={`text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold ${
                    order.severity === "CRITICAL" ? "badge-critical" : "badge-high"
                  }`}>
                    {order.severity}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 line-clamp-2">
                  {order.recommended_action}
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                  <span>Cycle #{order.created_at_cycle}</span>
                  <span className="text-indigo-400 font-medium">Due: #{order.due_by_cycle}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Column 2: Needs Review (Exceptions) */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-amber-500/30">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse"></span>
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300">Exceptions</h3>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-amber-500/30">
              {exceptionOrders.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[550px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {exceptionOrders.map((order) => (
              <div 
                key={order.work_order_id} 
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(order)}
                className="glass-panel p-4 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer border-amber-500/30 hover:border-amber-500/60 transition-all space-y-2 bg-amber-500/5"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-amber-300">
                    {order.engine_id}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30">
                    HITL
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-200/90 font-medium">
                  {order.exception || "Model disagreement or high uncertainty"}
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                  <span>Cycle #{order.created_at_cycle}</span>
                  <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">Review Now →</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Column 3: Logistics & Spares (Dispatched & Parts Ordered) */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-cyan-500/20">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">2. Logistics</h3>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-cyan-400 bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-cyan-500/30">
              {logisticsOrders.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[550px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {logisticsOrders.map((order) => (
              <div 
                key={order.work_order_id} 
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(order)}
                className="glass-panel p-4 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer hover:border-cyan-500/40 transition-all space-y-2"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-white">
                    {order.engine_id}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30">
                    {order.status}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 line-clamp-2">
                  {order.recommended_action}
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                  <span>Cycle #{order.created_at_cycle}</span>
                  <span className="text-cyan-400 font-medium">Logistics Dispatched</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Column 4: Hangar Maintenance (In Progress & Runup) */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-purple-500/20">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Wrench className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">3. Hangar Work</h3>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-purple-400 bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-purple-500/30">
              {maintenanceOrders.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[550px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {maintenanceOrders.map((order) => (
              <div 
                key={order.work_order_id} 
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(order)}
                className="glass-panel p-4 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer hover:border-purple-500/40 transition-all space-y-2"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-white">
                    {order.engine_id}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30">
                    {order.status}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 line-clamp-2">
                  {order.recommended_action}
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono pt-1 border-t border-slate-800">
                  <span>Cycle #{order.created_at_cycle}</span>
                  <span className="text-purple-400 font-medium">Tech Assigned</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Column 5: Closed & Resolved */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-emerald-500/30">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <FileCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">4. Closed</h3>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/30">
              {closedOrders.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[550px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {closedOrders.map((order) => (
              <div 
                key={order.work_order_id} 
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(order)}
                className="glass-panel p-4 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer hover:border-emerald-500/40 transition-all space-y-2"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
                    {order.engine_id}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30">
                    {order.status}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 line-clamp-2">
                  {order.recommended_action}
                </p>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-mono pt-1 border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>Resolved</span>
                  <span>Closed #{order.closed_at_cycle || order.created_at_cycle}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Row: What-If Simulator & Rules Configuration Viewer */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 pt-4">
        {/* What-If Simulator */}
        <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sliders className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" />
            <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">What-If Policy Simulator</h3>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Simulate policy changes across the full fleet replay to preview dispatch impact before modifying production YAML rules.
          </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>Critical RUL Threshold: <span className="text-white font-mono font-bold">{simCrit} cycles</span></span>
                <span className="text-[9px] uppercase font-mono px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/20 font-semibold">POLICY</span>
              </label>
              <input 
                type="range" 
                min="5" 
                max="30" 
                value={simCrit} 
                onChange={(e) => setSimCrit(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-indigo-500"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>High RUL Threshold: <span className="text-white font-mono font-bold">{simHigh} cycles</span></span>
                <span className="text-[9px] uppercase font-mono px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/20 font-semibold">POLICY</span>
              </label>
              <input 
                type="range" 
                min="20" 
                max="50" 
                value={simHigh} 
                onChange={(e) => setSimHigh(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-purple-500"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <button 
            onClick={runWhatIf}
            disabled={isSimulating}
            className="glass-button text-white text-xs px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-semibold w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-all"
          >
            {isSimulating ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-cyan-300" />
                <span>Simulating Fleet Policies on {currentSubset}...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <span>Run What-If Simulation on {currentSubset}</span>
            )}
          </button>

          {simResult && (
            <div className="bg-slate-900/90 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-indigo-500/20 text-xs space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-white font-semibold">
                <span>Simulated Work Orders:</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-cyan-300 text-sm font-bold">{simResult.total_simulated_orders}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-4 text-slate-400 text-[11px]">
                <span>Critical: <b className="text-rose-400">{simResult.severities?.CRITICAL}</b></span>
                <span>High: <b className="text-amber-400">{simResult.severities?.HIGH}</b></span>
                <span>Medium: <b className="text-blue-400">{simResult.severities?.MEDIUM}</b></span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Rules Config Viewer */}
        <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Tag className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-400" />
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">Production Agent Rules (YAML)</h3>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-cyan-300 bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-cyan-500/20">
              v{rulesConfig?.rules_version || "2026-10-07.1"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-950/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 font-mono text-xs text-slate-300 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto space-y-1">
            <div className="text-indigo-400 font-semibold"># Severity Bands</div>
            <div>critical: &lt;= 15 cycles (Emergency Maintenance Dispatch)</div>
            <div>high: 16 - 30 cycles</div>
            <div>medium: 31 - 60 cycles</div>
            <div>low: 61 - 100 cycles (Watchlist)</div>
            <div className="text-purple-400 font-semibold mt-2"># Multi-Stage Industrial Lifecycle</div>
            <div>PROPOSED → APPROVED → DISPATCHED → PARTS_ORDERED → IN_PROGRESS → CLOSED</div>
            <div className="text-amber-400 font-semibold mt-2"># Exceptions (HITL Route)</div>
            <div>X1: Interval width &gt; 40 cycles</div>
            <div>X2: Anomaly &gt;= 0.80 but RUL &gt; 100</div>
            <div>X3: Sensor flatlines &gt;= 3 sensors</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modal / Drawer for Work Order Detail & Aerospace Lifecycle Stepper */}
      {selectedOrder && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="glass-panel w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl p-6 border-indigo-500/40 space-y-6 bg-[#0c0d16]">
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-indigo-500/20">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600/30 border border-indigo-500/40 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Plane className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-indigo-400 font-mono font-bold">
                    {selectedOrder.work_order_id}
                  </span>
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-white font-mono mt-0.5">
                    {selectedOrder.engine_id}
                  </h3>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                {/* One-click PDF download */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleDownloadWorkOrderPdf(selectedOrder)}
                  disabled={isDownloadingPdf}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600/30 hover:bg-indigo-600/50 border border-indigo-500/40 text-indigo-200 text-xs font-semibold transition-all shadow-md disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  {isDownloadingPdf ? (
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-indigo-300" />
                  ) : (
                    <FileDown className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-300" />
                  )}
                  <span>Maintenance Report PDF</span>
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(null)}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800"
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Industrial Multi-Stage Stepper */}
            <div className="space-y-2 bg-slate-950/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400 mb-2">
                <span className="font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">Work Order Industrial Lifecycle</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-cyan-300 font-bold">Current Stage: {selectedOrder.status}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-6 gap-2">
                {LIFECYCLE_STAGES.map((stage, idx) => {
                  const currentIdx = getStageIndex(selectedOrder.status);
                  const isCompleted = currentIdx > idx;
                  const isCurrent = currentIdx === idx;
                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={stage}
                      className={`p-2 rounded-xl text-center border text-[11px] font-mono transition-all ${
                        isCurrent 
                          ? "bg-indigo-600/30 border-indigo-500 text-white font-bold ring-1 ring-indigo-500" 
                          : isCompleted 
                            ? "bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300" 
                            : "bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-800 text-slate-500"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="text-[9px] uppercase opacity-75">Step {idx + 1}</div>
                      <div className="truncate mt-0.5">{stage.replace(/_/g, " ")}</div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Properties */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs bg-slate-900/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 block text-[10px] uppercase">Severity</span>
                <span className={`font-bold ${selectedOrder.severity === "CRITICAL" ? "text-rose-400" : "text-amber-400"}`}>
                  {selectedOrder.severity}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 block text-[10px] uppercase">Conservative RUL</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-white font-mono">{selectedOrder.conservative_rul} cycles</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 block text-[10px] uppercase">Suspected Subsystem</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-purple-300">{selectedOrder.suspected_subsystem || "HPC"}</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 block text-[10px] uppercase">Due By</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-cyan-300">Cycle #{selectedOrder.due_by_cycle || "—"}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Explainable Decision Trace */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
                <span>Explainable Decision Trace</span>
              </h4>
              <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 font-mono text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1">
                {selectedOrder.decision_trace?.map((rule: string, i: number) => (
                  <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-cyan-400 font-bold">→</span>
                    <span>{rule}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Human Actions & Multi-Stage Transition Controls */}
            <div className="space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
                  Industrial Lifecycle Controls &amp; Sign-off
                </h4>
                {selectedOrder.status !== "CLOSED" && (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleAdvance}
                    disabled={actionLoading}
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-cyan-600 hover:from-indigo-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all"
                  >
                    <span>Advance to Next Lifecycle Stage</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <input 
                type="text" 
                placeholder="Operator signoff comments or maintenance log notes..."
                value={actionReason}
                onChange={(e) => setActionReason(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full text-xs p-2.5 bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 text-white"
              />

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleAction("APPROVE")}
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                  className="flex-1 bg-emerald-600/30 hover:bg-emerald-600/50 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all"
                >
                  Authorize Order
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleAction("REJECT")}
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                  className="flex-1 bg-rose-600/30 hover:bg-rose-600/50 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all"
                >
                  Reject &amp; Dismiss
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleAction("CLOSE")}
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                  className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all"
                >
                  Close Out Order
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

========== D:\Projects\SelfHealingMachines\scripts\build_all_data.py ==========

import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT_DIR))

from src.features.pipeline import DataPipeline

def main():
    subsets = ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]
    print("=" * 60)
    print("Generating Feature & Data Pipeline Artifacts for FD001 - FD004")
    print("=" * 60)
    
    total_start = time.time()
    for sub in subsets:
        t0 = time.time()
        print(f"\n>>> Processing {sub}...")
        dp = DataPipeline(subset=sub, inject_faults=False)
        dp.run()
        print(f">>> {sub} finished in {time.time() - t0:.2f}s")
        
    print(f"\n[DONE] All 4 C-MAPSS subsets built successfully in {time.time() - total_start:.2f}s!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


========== D:\Projects\SelfHealingMachines\scripts\ci_smoke_test.py ==========

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
CI Smoke Test for AETURNUS
Validates end-to-end functionality across pipeline, models, agent, and API endpoints
in under 10 seconds.
"""
import sys
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Ensure root directory is on PYTHONPATH
root_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(root_dir))

def run_smoke_test():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("AETURNUS - CI Smoke Test")
    print("=" * 60)

    # 1. Configs & Rules
    print("[1/6] Validating configuration files...")
    from src.common.utils import load_yaml
    rules_cfg = load_yaml("configs/agent_rules.yaml")
    assert "severity_bands" in rules_cfg, "agent_rules.yaml missing severity_bands"
    assert "escalation" in rules_cfg, "agent_rules.yaml missing escalation"
    pipeline_cfg = load_yaml("configs/pipeline.yaml")
    assert "cleaning" in pipeline_cfg, "pipeline.yaml missing cleaning"
    monitoring_cfg = load_yaml("configs/monitoring.yaml")
    assert "drift" in monitoring_cfg, "monitoring.yaml missing drift"
    print("  --> Configurations loaded successfully.")

    # 2. Artifacts & Reports
    print("[2/6] Validating disk reports and model artifacts...")
    artifacts_dir = root_dir / "artifacts"
    reports_dir = artifacts_dir / "reports"
    models_dir = artifacts_dir / "models"
    
    for sub in ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]:
        eval_f = reports_dir / f"evaluation_{sub}.json"
        assert eval_f.exists(), f"Missing evaluation report: {eval_f}"
        with open(eval_f, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            d = json.load(f)
            assert "rmse" in d and d["rmse"] > 0, f"Invalid RMSE in {eval_f}"
            assert "multi_seed" in d, f"Missing multi_seed in {eval_f}"
        
        bundle_f = models_dir / f"model_bundle_{sub}.joblib"
        assert bundle_f.exists(), f"Missing model bundle: {bundle_f}"

    reg_f = reports_dir / "model_registry.json"
    assert reg_f.exists(), "Missing model_registry.json"
    print("  --> All FD001-FD004 artifacts & reports verified.")

    # 3. Data Cleaning & Regime Normalization
    print("[3/6] Testing DataCleaner and Causal Imputation...")
    from src.clean.cleaner import DataCleaner
    cleaner = DataCleaner({"cleaning": {"ffill_limit": 3, "outlier_z_clip": 4.0}})
    dummy_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "unit": [1, 1, 1],
        "cycle": [1, 2, 3],
        "setting_1": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        "s2": [np.nan, 100.0, 105.0]
    })
    cleaner.fit_train(pd.DataFrame({"s2": [90.0, 95.0, 100.0], "s3": [50.0, 51.0, 49.0]}))
    cleaned, _ = cleaner.clean_impute(dummy_df, is_train=False)
    assert cleaned.loc[0, "s2"] == 95.0, "Causal fallback failed"
    assert cleaned.loc[1, "s2"] == 100.0
    print("  --> Cleaner passes causal imputation and settings regex exclusion.")

    # 4. Triage Agent Rules & SQLite
    print("[4/6] Testing Triage Agent rule engine & UUID generation...")
    import uuid
    from src.agent.triage_agent import TriageAgent
    smoke_db = root_dir / "artifacts" / "smoke_test.db"
    if smoke_db.exists():
        smoke_db.unlink()
    agent = TriageAgent(db_path=smoke_db)
    pred = {
        "engine_id": "ENG-FD001-SMOKE",
        "unit": 1,
        "subset": "FD001",
        "cycle": 50,
        "conservative_rul": 12.0,
        "rul_p10": 10.0,
        "rul_p50": 15.0,
        "rul_p90": 22.0,
        "fail_prob_30": 0.88,
        "anomaly_score": 0.75,
        "model_version": "rul-fd001@champion"
    }
    order, trace = agent.evaluate_engine_cycle(pred)
    assert order is not None, "Agent failed to create order"
    assert order["severity"] == "CRITICAL", f"Expected CRITICAL, got {order['severity']}"
    wo_id = order["work_order_id"]
    assert wo_id.startswith("WO-"), f"Expected WO- prefix, got {wo_id}"
    uuid_obj = uuid.UUID(wo_id[3:])
    assert f"WO-{str(uuid_obj)}" == wo_id, "work_order_id is not a valid UUID"
    try:
        if smoke_db.exists():
            smoke_db.unlink()
    except Exception:
        pass
    print("  --> Agent produced valid UUID order and proper audit trace.")

    # 5. FastAPI Endpoints & Contract
    print("[5/6] Testing FastAPI Server Endpoints via TestClient...")
    from scripts.entrypoint import ensure_data_and_models
    ensure_data_and_models()
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
    from src.api.server import app
    client = TestClient(app)

    # Health
    r = client.get("/api/v1/health")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Health check failed: {r.text}"

    # Benchmark
    r = client.get("/api/v1/models/benchmark")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Benchmark failed: {r.text}"
    bench = r.json()
    assert "benchmarks" in bench, "Expected benchmarks key in benchmark endpoint"
    assert len(bench["benchmarks"]) == 4, "Expected 4 datasets in benchmark"

    # Fleet
    r = client.get("/api/v1/fleet?subset=FD001")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Fleet failed: {r.text}"
    fleet = r.json()
    assert "engines" in fleet and len(fleet["engines"]) > 0, "Fleet empty"

    # Model Details
    r = client.get("/api/v1/models/FD001/details")
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"Model details failed: {r.text}"
    details = r.json()
    assert "bucket_errors" in details, "Missing bucket_errors in details"

    # 400 Validation on Invalid Subset
    r = client.get("/api/v1/fleet?subset=INVALID")

import os

def ensure_data_and_models():
    """
    Ensures that raw data, processed pipelines, and trained model bundles
    exist on the machine before starting the API server.
    """
    print("=" * 60)
    print("  AETURNUS: Verifying Data, Pipeline & Model Artifacts")
    print("=" * 60)

    # 1. Download raw data if missing
    raw_fd001 = ROOT_DIR / "data" / "raw" / "train_FD001.txt"
    if not raw_fd001.exists():
        print("[ENTRYPOINT] Raw C-MAPSS dataset missing. Running download_data...")
        import download_data
        download_data.download_and_extract()
    else:
        print("[ENTRYPOINT] Raw dataset present.")

    # 2. Build feature pipelines if processed parquets are missing
    fd001_train = ROOT_DIR / "data" / "processed" / "FD001" / "train.parquet"
    fd001_test = ROOT_DIR / "data" / "processed" / "FD001" / "test.parquet"
    if not (fd001_train.exists() and fd001_test.exists()):
        print("[ENTRYPOINT] Primary dataset FD001 missing. Building FD001 pipeline...")
        from src.features.pipeline import DataPipeline
        dp = DataPipeline("FD001")
        dp.run()
        del dp
        import gc
        gc.collect()
    else:
        print("[ENTRYPOINT] Primary dataset FD001 present.")

    # Build other subsets if explicitly requested or outside memory-constrained environments
    build_all = os.environ.get("BUILD_ALL_DATASETS", "0") == "1"
    subsets = ["FD002", "FD003", "FD004"] if build_all else []
    for sub in subsets:
        sub_train = ROOT_DIR / "data" / "processed" / sub / "train.parquet"
        if not sub_train.exists():
            print(f"[ENTRYPOINT] Building pipeline for {sub}...")
            from src.features.pipeline import DataPipeline
            dp = DataPipeline(sub)
            dp.run()
            del dp
            import gc
            gc.collect()

    # 3. Train models if bundles are missing
    subsets_to_check = ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]
    missing_models = [
        sub for sub in subsets_to_check
        if not (ROOT_DIR / "artifacts" / "models" / f"model_bundle_{sub}.joblib").exists()
    ]
    if missing_models:
        print(f"[ENTRYPOINT] Model bundles missing for {missing_models}. Training models...")
        import scripts.train_all_models as train_all_models
        train_all_models.main()
    else:
        print("[ENTRYPOINT] Model bundles present.")

    print("=" * 60)
    print("  AETURNUS: System Artifacts Verified.")
    print("=" * 60)

def main():
    ensure_data_and_models()
    import run_app
    run_app.main()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys

def compute_git_sha(root_dir: Path) -> str:
    try:
        out = subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
            cwd=str(root_dir),
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL
        ).decode().strip()
        if len(out) == 40:
            return out
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "a000000000000000000000000000000000000000"

def compute_config_hash(root_dir: Path) -> str:
    hasher = hashlib.sha256()
    configs_dir = root_dir / "configs"
    for p in sorted(configs_dir.glob("*.yaml")):
        hasher.update(p.name.encode("utf-8"))
        hasher.update(p.read_bytes())
    return hasher.hexdigest()

def compute_data_sha256(root_dir: Path, subsets: list) -> dict:
    data_hashes = {}
    for sub in subsets:
        tr_p = root_dir / "data" / "processed" / sub / "train.parquet"
        te_p = root_dir / "data" / "processed" / sub / "test.parquet"
        if tr_p.exists():
            data_hashes[f"{sub}_train"] = hashlib.sha256(tr_p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if te_p.exists():
            data_hashes[f"{sub}_test"] = hashlib.sha256(te_p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return data_hashes

def select_champion(comparison_models: list) -> dict:
    """
    Selects champion algorithm based on protocol rules:
    Filter candidate models with late_rate <= 0.60, then select minimum CV RMSE.
    Records per-candidate CV mean+-std, the margin between top 2;
    if margin < one std of leader, uses tie-break rule.
    """
    rule_inputs = {
        "max_acceptable_late_rate": 0.60,
        "primary_metric": "cv_mean_rmse",
        "secondary_metric": "cv_mean_nasa",
        "evaluated_algorithms": [m.get("model_name", "") for m in comparison_models]
    }
    
    # Filter candidates without literal defaults
    valid_candidates = [m for m in comparison_models if ("late_rate" not in m or m["late_rate"] <= 0.60)]
    if not valid_candidates:
        valid_candidates = comparison_models

    # Sort candidates by cv_mean_rmse
    sorted_candidates = sorted(
        valid_candidates,
        key=lambda m: (m["cv_mean_rmse"] if "cv_mean_rmse" in m else m.get("rmse", 999.0))
    )
    leader = sorted_candidates[0]
    leader_rmse = float(leader["cv_mean_rmse"] if "cv_mean_rmse" in leader else leader["rmse"])
    leader_std = float(leader["cv_std_rmse"] if "cv_std_rmse" in leader else 1.0)
    
    runner_up = sorted_candidates[1] if len(sorted_candidates) > 1 else leader
    runner_up_rmse = float(runner_up["cv_mean_rmse"] if "cv_mean_rmse" in runner_up else runner_up["rmse"])
    margin = float(runner_up_rmse - leader_rmse)

    per_candidate_cv = {}
    for m in comparison_models:
        name = m.get("model_name", "unknown")
        per_candidate_cv[name] = {
            "mean_rmse": m.get("cv_mean_rmse"),
            "std_rmse": m.get("cv_std_rmse"),
            "mean_nasa": m.get("cv_mean_nasa"),
            "std_nasa": m.get("cv_std_nasa")
        }

    # If margin < one std of leader, use tie_break rule
    if margin < leader_std:
        tie_break_rule = "val_nasa_phm08"
        close_candidates = [
            m for m in sorted_candidates
            if (float(m["cv_mean_rmse"] if "cv_mean_rmse" in m else m["rmse"]) - leader_rmse) < leader_std
        ]
        best = min(
            close_candidates,
            key=lambda m: (m["cv_mean_nasa"] if "cv_mean_nasa" in m else m.get("nasa_score", 999999.0))
        )
        selection_rule = f"cv_rmse_within_1std_tiebreak_{tie_break_rule}"
    else:
        tie_break_rule = None
        best = leader
        selection_rule = "min_cv_rmse_margin_decisive"

    # Canonical algorithm key inside bundle
    algo_name = "lightgbm"
    b_name = best.get("model_name", "").lower()
    if "ridge" in b_name:
        algo_name = "ridge"
    elif "hist" in b_name:
        algo_name = "hist_gb"
        
    return {
        "selected_algorithm": algo_name,
        "model_name": best.get("model_name", "LightGBM Regressor (Champion)"),
        "selection_rule": selection_rule,
        "margin": round(margin, 3),
        "margin_threshold_std": round(leader_std, 3),
        "tie_break": tie_break_rule,
        "per_candidate_cv": per_candidate_cv,
        "rule_inputs": rule_inputs
    }

def evaluate_subset(sub: str, root_dir: Path, force: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    test_path = root_dir / "data" / "processed" / sub / "test.parquet"
    train_path = root_dir / "data" / "processed" / sub / "train.parquet"
    test_df = pd.read_parquet(test_path)
    train_df = pd.read_parquet(train_path)
    loader = CMAPSSLoader(subset=sub)
    _, _, rul_truth = loader.load_raw_data()
    targets_cfg = load_yaml(root_dir / "configs" / "targets.yaml")
    protocol_id = get_protocol_id()

    # Load active champion service
    ms = ModelService(subset=sub).load()

    # 5-fold GroupKFold Cross-Validation on persistent train engines
    cv_path = root_dir / "artifacts" / "reports" / f"cv_{sub}.json"
    if cv_path.exists() and not force:
        print(f">>> Reusing existing 5-fold CV evaluation from {cv_path.name}...")
        with open(cv_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            cv_res = json.load(f)
    else:
        print(f">>> Running 5-fold CV evaluation for {sub}...")
        cv_res = ms.evaluate_cv(k=5, train_df=train_df)

    # Multi-seed evaluation over 3 seeds
    eval_path = root_dir / "artifacts" / "reports" / f"evaluation_{sub}.json"
    multi_seed = {}
    if eval_path.exists() and not force:
        try:
            with open(eval_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                multi_seed = json.load(f).get("multi_seed", {})
        except Exception:
            multi_seed = {}
    if not multi_seed:
        print(f">>> Running 3-seed evaluation for {sub}...")
        multi_seed = ms.evaluate_multi_seed(train_df, test_df, rul_truth, seeds=[42, 43, 44])

    # Deep learning and baseline comparison
    comp_path = root_dir / "artifacts" / "reports" / f"model_comparison_{sub}.json"
    if comp_path.exists() and not force:
        print(f">>> Reusing existing algorithm comparison from {comp_path.name}...")
        with open(comp_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            comp_res = json.load(f)
    else:
        print(f">>> Running algorithm comparison for {sub}...")
        comp_res = ms.compare_deep_learning_models(train_df, test_df, rul_truth)

    # Champion selection via protocol
    champ_decision = select_champion(comp_res["models"])
    selected_algo = champ_decision["selected_algorithm"]
    print(f">>> Selected Champion for {sub}: {selected_algo}")

    # Ensure active served bundle matches selected champion algorithm
    if getattr(ms, "algorithm", "") != selected_algo:
        print(f">>> Retraining served champion bundle for {sub} with {selected_algo}...")
        ms.algorithm = selected_algo
        ms.train(train_df)
        ms.save(version=getattr(ms, "version", "v1.0"))
        ms.promote()
    else:
        ms.save(version=getattr(ms, "version", "v1.0"))
        ms.promote()

    active_bundle_path = root_dir / "artifacts" / "models" / f"model_bundle_{sub}.joblib"
    
    # Now evaluate test on the active served bundle using canonical eval_frames
    eval_rows = eval_frames(test_df, mode="last", seed=42, n_draws=1)[0]
    res = ms.evaluate_test(test_df, rul_truth)

    # Compute full bundle sha256
    bundle_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(active_bundle_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

    # Compute target and target_met strictly from configs/targets.yaml policy
    raw_target = targets_cfg["subsets"][sub]["target_rmse"]
    target_val = float(raw_target["value"]) if isinstance(raw_target, dict) and "value" in raw_target else float(raw_target)
    target_met = bool(res["rmse"] <= target_val)

    # Prepare exact test metrics without fallback defaults
    metrics = {
        "rmse": float(res["rmse"]),
        "mae": float(res["mae"]),
        "nasa_score": float(res["nasa_score"]),
        "early_rate": float(res["early_rate"]),
        "late_rate": float(res["late_rate"]),
        "pr_auc": float(res["pr_auc"]),
        "interval_coverage": float(res["interval_coverage"]),
        "mean_interval_width": float(res["mean_interval_width"])
    }

    sub_dict = {
        "bundle_sha256": bundle_sha256,
        "algorithm": selected_algo,
        "protocol_id": protocol_id,
        "n_engines": len(eval_rows),
        "target_rmse": target_val,
        "target_met": target_met,
        "metrics": metrics,
        "cv": {
            "protocol_id": protocol_id,
            "k_folds": cv_res["k_folds"],
            "mean_rmse": cv_res["mean_rmse"],
            "std_rmse": cv_res["std_rmse"],
            "mean_nasa": cv_res["mean_nasa"],
            "std_nasa": cv_res["std_nasa"],
            "mean_train_rmse": cv_res["mean_train_rmse"]
        },
        "comparison_rows": comp_res["models"],
        "champion": champ_decision,
        "condition": res["condition"],
        "faults": res["faults"],
        "status": "Target Met" if target_met else "Target Missed",
        "train_time_sec": res["train_time_sec"],
        "multi_seed": multi_seed
    }
    return sub_dict

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Force full recomputation of CV and comparisons")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    force = args.force

    root_dir = get_root_dir()
    subsets = ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]
    print("=" * 60)
    print("Evaluating Official C-MAPSS Benchmarks & Building Run Manifest")
    print("=" * 60)

    git_sha = compute_git_sha(root_dir)
    config_hash = compute_config_hash(root_dir)
    data_sha256 = compute_data_sha256(root_dir, subsets)
    targets_cfg = load_yaml(root_dir / "configs" / "targets.yaml")
    run_id = f"run_{int(time.time())}_{git_sha[:8]}"

    manifest_subsets = {}
    benchmarks = []

    for sub in subsets:
        print(f"\n>>> Evaluating {sub}...")
        sub_info = evaluate_subset(sub, root_dir, force=force)
        manifest_subsets[sub] = sub_info
        benchmarks.append({
            "subset": sub,
            "condition": sub_info["condition"],
            "faults": sub_info["faults"],
            "rmse": sub_info["metrics"]["rmse"],
            "mae": sub_info["metrics"]["mae"],
            "nasa_score": sub_info["metrics"]["nasa_score"],
            "early_rate": sub_info["metrics"]["early_rate"],
            "late_rate": sub_info["metrics"]["late_rate"],
            "nasa_phm08": sub_info.get("champion", {}),
            "pr_auc": sub_info["metrics"]["pr_auc"],
            "train_time_sec": sub_info["train_time_sec"],
            "target_rmse": sub_info["target_rmse"],
            "target_met": sub_info["target_met"],
            "status": sub_info["status"],
            "interval_coverage": sub_info["metrics"]["interval_coverage"],
            "mean_interval_width": sub_info["metrics"]["mean_interval_width"],
            "multi_seed": sub_info.get("multi_seed", {}),
            "deep_comparison": sub_info.get("comparison_rows", [])
        })

    # Assemble complete manifest
    manifest_data = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "git_sha": git_sha,
        "config_hash": config_hash,
        "data_sha256": data_sha256,
        "created_at": time.time(),
        "subsets": manifest_subsets
    }

    # Atomically write run_manifest.json
    manifest_file = root_dir / "artifacts" / "run_manifest.json"
    manifest_tmp = root_dir / "artifacts" / "run_manifest.json.tmp"
    manifest_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(manifest_tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(manifest_data, f, indent=2)
    manifest_tmp.replace(manifest_file)
    print(f"\n[DONE] Atomically written run manifest to {manifest_file}")

    # Write legacy benchmark_summary.json for backward compatibility
    summary_file = root_dir / "artifacts" / "reports" / "benchmark_summary.json"
    summary_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(summary_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"benchmarks": benchmarks}, f, indent=2)

    for sub, sinfo in manifest_subsets.items():
        m = sinfo["metrics"]
        print(f"  [{sub}] Champion: {sinfo['algorithm']} | RMSE: {m['rmse']:.2f} | MAE: {m['mae']:.2f} | NASA: {m['nasa_score']:.1f} | Cov: {m['interval_coverage']*100:.1f}%")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

# Add project root to sys.path
root_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(root_dir) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root_dir))

from src.common.utils import get_root_dir

def generate_subset_table(reports_dir: Path) -> str:
    subsets_meta = {
        "FD001": ("Single (Sea Level)", "HPC Degradation"),
        "FD002": ("Six Regimes (Multi)", "HPC Degradation"),
        "FD003": ("Single (Sea Level)", "HPC + Fan Degradation"),
        "FD004": ("Six Regimes (Multi)", "HPC + Fan Degradation"),
    }

    headers = [
        "| Dataset Subset | Operating Conditions | Fault Modes | Test Engines | Champion RMSE | NASA Asymmetric Score | PR-AUC (Fail $\\le 30$) | Conformal Coverage | Target Status |",
        "|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|"
    ]
    rows = []

    for sub in ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]:
        eval_file = reports_dir / f"evaluation_{sub}.json"
        cond, faults = subsets_meta.get(sub, ("Standard", "Degradation"))
        if eval_file.exists():
            with open(eval_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                d = json.load(f)
            rmse = f"**{d['rmse']:.2f}**" if "rmse" in d else "N/A"
            nasa = f"**{d['nasa_score']:,.1f}**" if "nasa_score" in d else "N/A"
            pr_auc = f"**{d['pr_auc']:.3f}**" if "pr_auc" in d else "N/A"
            cov = f"{d['interval_coverage'] * 100:.1f}%" if "interval_coverage" in d else "N/A"
            n_engines = d["test_engines_count"] if "test_engines_count" in d else "N/A"
            status_text = d.get("status", "").upper()
            if "MET" in status_text and "MISSED" not in status_text:
                status_html = '<span style="color:#22c55e;font-weight:bold;">TARGET REACHED</span>'
            else:
                status_html = '<span style="color:#ef4444;font-weight:bold;">TARGET MISSED</span>'
        else:
            rmse, nasa, pr_auc, cov, n_engines = "N/A", "N/A", "N/A", "N/A", "N/A"
            status_html = "PENDING"

        rows.append(f"| **{sub}** | {cond} | {faults} | {n_engines} | {rmse} | {nasa} | {pr_auc} | {cov} | {status_html} |")

    return "\n".join(headers + rows)


def generate_multi_seed_table(reports_dir: Path) -> str:
    headers = [
        "| Subset | RMSE ($mean \\pm std$) | MAE ($mean \\pm std$) | NASA Score ($mean \\pm std$) | PR-AUC ($mean \\pm std$) |",
        "|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|"
    ]
    rows = []

    for sub in ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]:
        eval_file = reports_dir / f"evaluation_{sub}.json"
        if eval_file.exists():
            with open(eval_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                d = json.load(f)
            ms = d.get("multi_seed", {})
            if ms:
                rmse = f"${ms['rmse_mean']:.2f} \\pm {ms['rmse_std']:.2f}$" if "rmse_mean" in ms else "N/A"
                mae = f"${ms['mae_mean']:.2f} \\pm {ms['mae_std']:.2f}$" if "mae_mean" in ms else "N/A"
                nasa = f"${ms['nasa_mean']:,.1f} \\pm {ms['nasa_std']:.1f}$" if "nasa_mean" in ms else "N/A"
                prauc = f"${ms['pr_auc_mean']:.3f} \\pm {ms['pr_auc_std']:.3f}$" if "pr_auc_mean" in ms else "N/A"
            else:
                rmse = f"${d['rmse']:.2f}$" if "rmse" in d else "N/A"
                mae = f"${d['mae']:.2f}$" if "mae" in d else "N/A"
                nasa = f"${d['nasa_score']:,.1f}$" if "nasa_score" in d else "N/A"
                prauc = f"${d['pr_auc']:.3f}$" if "pr_auc" in d else "N/A"
        else:
            rmse, mae, nasa, prauc = "N/A", "N/A", "N/A", "N/A"

        rows.append(f"| **{sub}** | {rmse} | {mae} | {nasa} | {prauc} |")

    return "\n".join(headers + rows)


def generate_model_comparison_table(reports_dir: Path) -> str:
    headers = [
        "| Subset | Architecture | Model Name | 5-Fold CV RMSE (Train) | Test RMSE | Test MAE | Training Speed |",
        "|:---:|:---:|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|"
    ]
    rows = []

    for sub in ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]:
        comp_file = reports_dir / f"model_comparison_{sub}.json"
        if comp_file.exists():
            with open(comp_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                d = json.load(f)
            champ_name = d.get("champion", "")
            for m in d.get("models", []):
                name = m.get("model_name", "Model")
                arch = m.get("architecture", "")
                cv_rmse = f"{m['cv_mean_rmse']:.2f}" if "cv_mean_rmse" in m else "N/A"
                rmse = f"{m['rmse']:.2f}" if "rmse" in m else "N/A"
                mae = f"{m['mae']:.2f}" if "mae" in m else "N/A"
                time_s = m["train_time_sec"] if "train_time_sec" in m else 0.0
                speed = f"~{time_s:.1f}s" if time_s > 0 else "N/A"
                is_champ = (name == champ_name) or ("Champion" in name)
                if is_champ:
                    display_name = name if "Champion" in name else f"{name} (Champion)"
                    rows.append(f"| **{sub}** | **{arch}** | **{display_name}** | **{cv_rmse}** | **{rmse}** | **{mae}** | *{speed}* |")
                else:
                    rows.append(f"| {sub} | {arch} | {name} | {cv_rmse} | {rmse} | {mae} | {speed} |")

    if not rows:
        return ""
    return "\n".join(headers + rows)


def update_readme():
    from scripts.render_readme import update_or_check_readme
    return update_or_check_readme(check_only=False)

def _unused_old_update_readme():
    root_dir = get_root_dir()
    readme_path = root_dir / "README.md"
    reports_dir = root_dir / "artifacts" / "reports"

    with open(readme_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        content = f.read()

    # 1. Remove unsupported claims
    content = content.replace("with absolute zero hardcoded numbers", "with empirical verification from artifact reports")
    content = content.replace("Hampel outlier filtering", "robust outlier clipping")
    content = content.replace("Hampel clipping", "outlier clipping")
    content = content.replace("Causal Imputer & Hampel", "Causal Imputer & Outlier Clipper")
    content = content.replace("Hampel", "Outlier Clipper")
    content = content.replace("2-Layer BiGRU + Linear", "Sequence GRU + Linear")
    content = content.replace("BiGRU", "GRU")
    content = content.replace("Zero-Falsification Guarantee", "Empirically Verified Metrics")
    content = content.replace("Zero-Falsification", "Empirical Verification")
    content = content.replace("100% deterministic", "Fully deterministic")
    content = content.replace("42%20Passed", "69%20Passed")
    content = content.replace("42-test Pytest suite", "69-test Pytest suite across 20 test modules")
    content = content.replace("42-test", "69-test")

    # 2. Update Subset Performance Matrix table
    subset_tbl = generate_subset_table(reports_dir)
    subset_pattern = r"(### Subset Performance Matrix \(FD001–FD004\)\s*\n\n[^\n]+\n\n)\| Dataset Subset \|[\s\S]*?(?=\n\n> \[!NOTE\]|\n\n### Multi-Seed)"
    content = re.sub(subset_pattern, lambda m: m.group(1) + subset_tbl, content)

    # 3. Update Multi-Seed Robustness table
    multi_seed_tbl = generate_multi_seed_table(reports_dir)
    seed_pattern = r"(### Multi-Seed Robustness Analysis\s*\n\n[^\n]+\n\n)\| Subset \|[\s\S]*?(?=\n\n### Deep Learning|\n\n---)"
    content = re.sub(seed_pattern, lambda m: m.group(1) + multi_seed_tbl, content)

    # 4. Update Deep Learning comparison table if present
    comp_tbl = generate_model_comparison_table(reports_dir)
    if comp_tbl:
        comp_pattern = r"(### Deep Learning Architecture Comparison\s*\n\n[^\n]+\n\n)\| Subset \|[\s\S]*?(?=\n\n---|\n\n## 🧠)"
        content = re.sub(comp_pattern, lambda m: m.group(1) + comp_tbl, content)

    # 5. Fix stale empirical coverage prose from actual evaluation reports
    coverages = {}
    for sub in ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]:
        f_eval = reports_dir / f"evaluation_{sub}.json"
        if f_eval.exists():
            try:
                with open(f_eval, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    cov_val = json.load(f).get("interval_coverage")
                    if cov_val is not None:
                        coverages[sub] = float(cov_val) * 100.0
            except Exception:
                pass
    if coverages:
        min_cov = min(coverages.values())
        max_cov = max(coverages.values())
        c1 = f"{coverages.get('FD001', 86.0):.1f}%"
        c2 = f"{coverages.get('FD002', 62.6):.1f}%"
        c3 = f"{coverages.get('FD003', 82.0):.1f}%"
        c4 = f"{coverages.get('FD004', 60.0):.1f}%"
        cov_section = (
            f"#### 🎯 Empirical Coverage ({min_cov:.1f}%–{max_cov:.1f}%) vs 80% Nominal Target\n"
            f"On standard held-out NASA C-MAPSS test engines, the empirical conformal coverage achieved across subsets is:\n"
            f"- **FD001**: **{c1}** (Single condition, single fault — well exceeds nominal 80% target)\n"
            f"- **FD002**: **{c2}** (Six operational regimes, single fault — non-stationary flight conditions)\n"
            f"- **FD003**: **{c3}** (Single condition, dual fault — compounding HPC + Fan wear)\n"
            f"- **FD004**: **{c4}** (Six operational regimes, dual fault — maximum operating complexity)\n\n"
            f"**Why empirical coverage varies across regimes**:"
        )
        content = re.sub(
            r"#### 🎯 Empirical Coverage \([\d\.\%–\-]+\) vs 80% Nominal Target[\s\S]*?\*\*Why empirical coverage is [^\*]+:\*\*",
            cov_section,
            content
        )

    with open(readme_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(content)

    print("[SUCCESS] README tables and claims successfully generated and updated.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    update_readme()


========== D:\Projects\SelfHealingMachines\scripts\render_readme.py ==========

import sys
import json
import argparse
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT_DIR))

from src.common.utils import get_root_dir

START_MARKER = "<!-- AUTO-METRICS-START -->"
END_MARKER = "<!-- AUTO-METRICS-END -->"

from src.ingest.loader import CMAPSSLoader

def render_metrics_block(manifest: dict) -> str:
    lines = [
        START_MARKER,
        "### 🏆 C-MAPSS Empirical Benchmark Performance (FD001–FD004)",
        "",
        "> [!NOTE]",
        "> **Canonical Run Provenance**  ",
        f"> **Run ID**: `{manifest.get('run_id', 'N/A')}` | **Git SHA**: `{manifest.get('git_sha', 'N/A')[:10]}` | **Config Hash**: `{manifest.get('config_hash', 'N/A')[:10]}`  ",
        "> *All figures are derived directly from model bundles and authentic C-MAPSS evaluation parquets at run time.*",
        "",
        "| Dataset Subset | Operating Conditions | Fault Modes | Test Engines | Champion Model | Test RMSE | Test MAE | NASA Asymmetric Score | PR-AUC (Fail $\\le 30$) | Conformal Coverage | Target Status |",
        "|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|"
    ]

    subsets = manifest.get("subsets", {})
    for sub in ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]:
        s_data = subsets.get(sub, {})
        m = s_data.get("metrics", {})
        
        # Read operating conditions and fault modes strictly from loader metadata
        loader = CMAPSSLoader(subset=sub)
        cond = loader.operating_conditions
        faults = loader.fault_modes
        n_eng = s_data["n_engines"] if "n_engines" in s_data else len(loader.load_raw_data()[2])
        algo = s_data.get("algorithm", "lightgbm").upper()
        
        rmse = f"**{m['rmse']:.2f}**" if "rmse" in m else "N/A"
        mae = f"{m['mae']:.2f}" if "mae" in m else "N/A"
        nasa = f"**{m['nasa_score']:,.1f}**" if "nasa_score" in m else "N/A"
        pr_auc = f"{m['pr_auc']:.3f}" if "pr_auc" in m else "N/A"
        cov = f"{m['interval_coverage'] * 100:.1f}%" if "interval_coverage" in m else "N/A"
        
        # Read target_met strictly from manifest
        target_met = s_data.get("target_met", False)
        status = '<span style="color:#22c55e;font-weight:bold;">TARGET REACHED</span>' if target_met else '<span style="color:#ef4444;font-weight:bold;">TARGET MISSED</span>'
        
        lines.append(f"| **{sub}** | {cond} | {faults} | {n_eng} | **{algo}** | {rmse} | {mae} | {nasa} | {pr_auc} | {cov} | {status} |")

    lines.extend([
        "",
        "### 🔬 5-Fold GroupKFold Cross-Validation (Persistent Engines)",
        "",
        "| Subset | RMSE ($mean \\pm std$) | NASA Score ($mean \\pm std$) | Algorithm | Protocol ID |",
        "|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|"
    ])

    for sub in ["FD001", "FD002", "FD003", "FD004"]:
        s_data = subsets.get(sub, {})
        cv = s_data.get("cv", {})
        algo = s_data.get("algorithm", "lightgbm")
        proto = s_data.get("protocol_id", "canonical")
        cv_rmse = f"${cv['mean_rmse']:.2f} \\pm {cv['std_rmse']:.2f}$" if ("mean_rmse" in cv and "std_rmse" in cv) else "N/A"
        cv_nasa = f"${cv['mean_nasa']:,.1f} \\pm {cv['std_nasa']:.1f}$" if ("mean_nasa" in cv and "std_nasa" in cv) else "N/A"
        lines.append(f"| **{sub}** | {cv_rmse} | {cv_nasa} | `{algo}` | `{proto}` |")

    lines.extend([
        "",
        END_MARKER
    ])

    return "\n".join(lines)

def update_or_check_readme(check_only: bool = False) -> bool:
    root_dir = get_root_dir()
    manifest_file = root_dir / "artifacts" / "run_manifest.json"
    if not manifest_file.exists():
        print(f"[ERROR] Run manifest {manifest_file} missing. Run 'make evaluate' first.", file=sys.stderr)
        return False

    with open(manifest_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        manifest = json.load(f)

    rendered_block = render_metrics_block(manifest)
    readme_path = root_dir / "README.md"
    content = readme_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    if START_MARKER not in content or END_MARKER not in content:
        print(f"[ERROR] README.md missing {START_MARKER} or {END_MARKER}", file=sys.stderr)
        return False

    # Extract existing block
    before_part, rest = content.split(START_MARKER, 1)
    current_middle, after_part = rest.split(END_MARKER, 1)
    current_block = START_MARKER + current_middle + END_MARKER

    if check_only:
        # Strict comparison
        current_norm = "\n".join(line.rstrip() for line in current_block.strip().splitlines())
        rendered_norm = "\n".join(line.rstrip() for line in rendered_block.strip().splitlines())
        if current_norm != rendered_norm:
            print("[FAIL] README committed metrics differ from artifacts/run_manifest.json rendered block!", file=sys.stderr)
            print("--- Committed in README:\n", current_norm[:300], "...\n--- Rendered from Manifest:\n", rendered_norm[:300], "...", file=sys.stderr)
            return False
        print("[PASS] README metrics match run manifest exactly.")
        return True
    else:
        new_content = before_part + rendered_block + after_part
        readme_path.write_text(new_content, encoding="utf-8")
        print("[SUCCESS] Successfully updated README.md from run_manifest.json")
        return True

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Render or check README metrics block from run_manifest.json")
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="Fail if committed block differs from rendered one")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    success = update_or_check_readme(check_only=args.check)
    if not success:
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys

import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

if str(ROOT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT_DIR))

    print("=" * 60)
    print("Training Real Models for All Subsets (FD001 - FD004)")
    print("=" * 60)

    for sub in subsets:
        t0 = time.time()
        train_path = root_dir / "data" / "processed" / sub / "train.parquet"

        ms.save("v1.0")
        ms.promote("v1.0")
        print(f">>> {sub} trained and promoted in {time.time() - t0:.2f}s")

    print("\n[DONE] All models successfully trained and persisted.")
